nodes.long_description:
The Ultimate Mechanical Puzzle Experience in Virtual Reality!

Step into an immersive 3D workshop and rediscover the satisfaction of solving mechanical riddles like never before. VR Screw Puzzle: Nut & Bolt brings the popular unscrewing gameplay into a stunning virtual setting, where every turn feels impactful and every falling plate is a step toward mastery.

Take control of your tools with precise interactions using your controllers. Watch as you navigate a world of metal and wood, unscrewing bolts and triggering satisfying physics-based chain reactions. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing break or a strategic logic challenge, this game offers endless levels to test your skills.

Game Features:

Classic Logic, Reimagined for VR: Enjoy the familiar unscrewing mechanics with the added depth and immersion of a virtual reality environment.

Intuitive Controller Interactions: Grab and twist bolts with precision using your VR controllers for a natural and engaging workshop experience.

Stunning 3D Environments: Play amidst highly detailed textures and realistic lighting, creating a truly relaxing yet captivating atmosphere.

Endless Strategic Levels: Master the sequence and physics of every bolt to clear plates more efficiently and earn higher scores.

Satisfying Haptic Feedback: Feel the click and turn of every screw, enhancing the immersive feeling of working with real hardware.

Immersive Visuals and Sound: Experience crisp HD graphics and atmospheric audio that enhance the
nodes.short_description: Unleash your mechanical logic in a 3D workshop! Experience the ultimate physics-based challenge in VR with VR Screw Puzzle: Nut & Bolt. Aim, unscrew, and watch metal plates fall as you navigate through intricate layers of nuts and bolts in an immersive environment. With intuitive controller-based interactions and endless levels of brain-teasing fun, master the art of unscrewing and solve every complex puzzle!

nodes.long_description: Das ultimative mechanische Rätselerlebnis in Virtual Reality! Features: Klassische Logik, intuitive Steuerung mit VR-Controllern und haptisches Feedback bei jeder Drehung.
nodes.short_description: Entfesseln Sie Ihre mechanische Logik in einer 3D-Werkstatt! Erleben Sie die ultimative Physik-Herausforderung in VR. Schrauben lösen und Platten fallen sehen.

nodes.long_description: The Ultimate Mechanical Puzzle Experience in VR! Features: Classic unscrewing mechanics, intuitive controller interactions, and stunning 3D environments with realistic lighting.
